name: Sofitel Bangkok Sukhumvit
short_description: A 345-room Sukhumvit hotel between Soi 13 and 15, with a 31st-floor Club Millesime lounge, a tropical 9th-floor pool, and Belga's Belgian-inspired breakfast.
ai_summary: Sofitel Bangkok Sukhumvit sits on Sukhumvit Road between Soi 13 and Soi 15, within walking distance of Asok and Nana BTS/MRT stations and Bangkok's shopping, dining, and business districts. The 345-room hotel's Club Millesime lounge on the 31st floor offers complimentary afternoon tea and evening canapes and cocktails, while a tropical pool on the 9th floor and the signature MyBed with luxury cotton sheets draw consistent praise. Reviewers repeatedly call the breakfast at Belga among the best they've had in Bangkok, and staff service is described as excellent across departments, with only the pool area's midday heat noted as a minor drawback.

faqs.question: Does Sofitel Bangkok Sukhumvit have an executive lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Club Millesime lounge on the 31st floor offers complimentary afternoon tea and evening canapes and cocktails, available to suite guests and eligible ALL - Accor Live Limitless elite members.

faqs.question: Is Sofitel Bangkok Sukhumvit near the BTS?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits on Sukhumvit Road between Soi 13 and Soi 15, within walking distance of both Asok and Nana BTS/MRT stations, putting Bangkok's Sukhumvit shopping and dining strip and the wider transit network within easy reach.

reviews.title: Sofitel Sukhumvit Hotel Bangkok - 5 Star Luxury Review
reviews.summary: Praises the Sukhumvit location, the 31st-floor Club Millesime lounge's afternoon tea and evening canapes, the signature MyBed, and an exceptional Belga breakfast, calling the stay all that we had expected and more.
